function.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_member(_user_id uuid, _kind text, _title text, _body text, _order_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$BEGIN
 PERFORM public.assert_current_account_access(); -- bluebird-account-boundary-v1

BEGIN
  IF _user_id IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;
  PERFORM set_config('parkvault.trusted_operation','on', true);
  INSERT INTO public.notifications (user_id, kind, title, body, order_id)
  VALUES (_user_id, _kind, _title, _body, _order_id);
END;
END;$function$

indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX notifications_pkey ON public.notifications USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX notifications_user_unread ON public.notifications USING btree (user_id, created_at DESC)

triggers.name: mobile_notification_created
triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mobile_enqueue_notification()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
 if new.kind not in ('message','shopping_alert') then return new; end if;
 insert into public.mobile_push_outbox(notification_id,device_id,user_id)
 select new.id,d.id,new.user_id from public.mobile_push_devices d where d.user_id=new.user_id
 on conflict(notification_id,device_id) do nothing;
 return new;
end $function$
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER mobile_notification_created AFTER INSERT ON notifications FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION mobile_enqueue_notification()
